newTip: SQL and text cells in one document, with their results (.ipynb file)

link.copied: Couldn't open the link in the browser: {{url}} was copied

settings.title: Notebooks
settings.help: How much of each result a notebook keeps in its file. On screen you always see the whole result; the file keeps a preview.
settings.rowsHelp: Rows of each result saved in the file (1 to 1000).
settings.sizeHelp: A larger preview is cut even if it has fewer rows.
settings.resultsCapHelp: How many rows of each cell's result a DataFrame SQL cell loads (in memory, never on disk).
settings.awsProfileHelp: The ~/.aws profile DataFrame SQL cells use to read s3://. Empty: AWS_PROFILE or «default».

target.title: Where the notebook runs
target.inheritHelp: The cell runs where the notebook runs.
target.environmentHelp: Each person runs it on their own database for that environment. The file only keeps the environment's name.
target.mapIntro: The notebook uses the connection “{{name}}”, which doesn't exist on this machine. Which of your connections is it?
target.mapHelp: Remembered on this machine; the file doesn't change.
target.bindEnvironment: Choose the database of the “{{env}}” environment in the project and run again.
target.ambiguousIntro: Several connections on this machine are called “{{name}}”. Which one does this notebook use?
target.ambiguousHelp: Remembered for this file on this machine; the file doesn't change.
target.resultsHelp: SQL over the results of the cells above and files on your computer. Uses DuckDB's SQL and no connection.

summary.storedTip: What the file kept. Run the cell to see the whole result.
summary.droppedTip: “Don't save result”: the file keeps the summary, not the rows.

ai.explainTip: The assistant explains it from the query, the columns and the totals (never the rows)
ai.groupTip: The preview is cut: the assistant proposes a grouped version of the query, without running it
ai.busy: The assistant is answering another question.
ai.proposePrompt:
This is my notebook so far (headings and queries, no results). Propose the next SQL query that makes sense to continue the analysis, in a single code block, with one line explaining why.

{{outline}}
ai.proposePromptNative:
This is my notebook so far (headings and queries, no results). The cells run on {{engine}}. Propose the next query or command in {{engine}}'s language (not SQL) that makes sense to continue the analysis, in a single code block, with one line explaining why.

{{outline}}

cell.countTip: The order it last ran in
cell.runTip: Run the cell (⌘↵ / Ctrl+↵; ⇧↵ runs and moves to the next one)
cell.runFrom: Run from here to the end
cell.sqlPlaceholder: Write a query. ⌘↵ / Ctrl+↵ runs it
cell.textPlaceholder: Markdown text. ⌘↵ / Ctrl+↵ to see it
cell.emptyText: Empty text cell: double click to write
cell.foreignTip: {{language}} cell from another program: shown and saved as is, DBine doesn't run it

notice.title: Data preview
notice.body: This file includes a preview of the data you queried. To save it without them, turn on “Save without results” in the notebook's toolbar, or “Don't save result” on a cell.

save.conflict: The file changed on disk since you opened it: it wasn't saved. Reload it or overwrite it.

close.title: Unsaved changes
close.ask: {{name}} has unsaved changes. Save them before closing?
close.running: A cell of {{name}} is running. Cancel it and close the notebook?

toolbar.targetTip: Where the cells run (each one can have its own)
toolbar.withoutResultsTip: The file keeps the queries, the text and the summaries, without rows: for sharing it or putting it in git

tx.askClose: This notebook has an open transaction on {{where}}. Commit or roll back the changes before closing it?

name.label: Cell name
name.tip: Name of this cell's DataFrame: other DataFrame SQL cells query it as a table. Click to change it
name.invalid: “{{name}}” is not valid as a table name: use letters, numbers and _, starting with a letter or _, with no SQL words

loaded.title: DataFrames:
loaded.tip: The DataFrames this query uses (cells above and files), loaded as tables in the notebook's in-memory database
loaded.changedMany_one: {{files}} file changed since the last run
loaded.changedMany_many: {{files}} files changed since the last run
loaded.changedMany_other: {{files}} files changed since the last run

fileAccess.title: Read local files
fileAccess.lead_one: This notebook wants to read this file:
fileAccess.lead_many: This notebook wants to read these files:
fileAccess.lead_other: This notebook wants to read these files:
fileAccess.noteSaved: “Allow” applies to this run only. “Always allow” remembers it on this computer for this notebook (not in the file): another file, or another notebook, asks again.
fileAccess.noteUnsaved: “Allow” applies to this run only. To remember it, save the notebook.
fileAccess.alwaysTip: This notebook will be able to read these files (and new ones matching the same pattern) without asking again
fileAccess.alwaysUnsaved: Save the notebook to remember it
fileAccess.denied_many: Reading these files was not allowed: {{files}}
fileAccess.denied_other: Reading these files was not allowed: {{files}}
fileAccess.remoteNote: DBine downloads what you allow to a private temporary folder, reads it and deletes it. Only public servers over https:// and AWS, Google Cloud and Azure storage, using this computer's session: credentials never go in the notebook.

fileGrants.title: Files notebooks can read
fileGrants.help: The ones allowed with “Always allow”, on this computer. If you move or rename a notebook, it asks again.
fileGrants.helpOne: The ones this notebook can read without asking, on this computer. If you move or rename it, it asks again.
fileGrants.unsaved: An unsaved notebook doesn't remember files: save it to always allow them.
fileGrants.clearConfirm_one: Remove the permission? The notebook will ask again before reading that file.
fileGrants.clearConfirm_many: Remove all {{count}} permissions? Notebooks will ask again before reading those files.
fileGrants.clearConfirm_other: Remove all {{count}} permissions? Notebooks will ask again before reading those files.
fileGrants.toolbarTip: The local files this notebook can read without asking
